results.title: Notion AI Data Breach: What the Fireworks Incident Exposed
results.description: Below is what is confirmed so far (as of November 11, 2026), what is still unclear, and what to do if you use Notion AI. Details are still developing, so expect updates from both companies. Fireworks AI is an inference provider: companies send it prompts and it runs open-weight AI models for them. Notion used Fireworks for some Notion AI workloads. Fireworks first disclosed a security incident involving unauthorized use of internal Fireworks credentials. Its bulletin said an unauthorized third party accessed environment variables used in evaluation jobs in a limited number of customer accounts, and told affected customers to rotate the credentials named in their notice.
